_note: The models the machine lane uses (scripts/auto/lane.py reads this file; change it here, not in the code). 15 November 2026: all three answered the probe with plain words and well-formed JSON; the models that think aloud first (qwen3, gemma-4, glm-4.7) answered nothing within the probe's short limit and are not used until that is handled. The checker is another model than the writer. Which model checks best is what the exam says (data/auto/exam/model-*.json). with_groq: the roles done at Groq once the secret GROQ_API_KEY exists (scripts/auto/llm.py; its free plan: 200,000 tokens a day for each model); without the key, or when its free day is used up, the models above do them. The checker there (Qwen) is of another family than the writer; it sits the exam before its verdicts count for more than the present checker's. Changed on 16 November 2026 after the writers' trial (data/auto/exam/writer-trial.json): gpt-oss-120b reasons for some 1,300 tokens before it writes and gave no draft in the room it had; llama-3.3-70b gave a draft in the right form in 174 tokens and named each source properly; mistral-small invented a limit. So llama-3.3-70b writes, and gpt-oss-120b, which reasons, is the second reader (the second reader is never the model that wrote). Teams (16 November 2026; scripts/auto/lane.py, team()): with a second free service (Groq) there are two day's allowances, and the lane takes for each answer the first team whose services have a key and room. Team A: gpt-oss-120b, the better writer in the trial, writes at Groq, and a model of another family (qwen3.8-27b) is the second reader; it stands first only while its second reader has not failed the exam (data/auto/exam/). Team B is the pair that wrote lanes 4 to 6: llama-3.3-70b writes, gpt-oss-120b is the second reader (at Groq where there is room, else at Cloudflare). The reader is llama-4-scout at Cloudflare, or gpt-oss-20b at Groq when Cloudflare's day is used up. Without a Groq key only team B with every model at Cloudflare can work, as before.
